name: Pink-legged Graveteiro
rangeDescription: Southeastern bahia and extreme northeastern minas gerais, eastern brazil
description: Predominantly gray species with a long tail and pink legs. Note the darker gray crown and paler eyebrow.

name: Black-throated Wren
rangeDescription: Caribbean lowlands of eastern nicaragua to western panama
description: This distinctive wren is noticeably dark: all brown with a black throat and just a few thin white markings on the face. Sexes alike.

name: Tolima Blossomcrown
rangeDescription: East slope of central andes of colombia (tolima and northern huila)
description: Small hummingbird mostly confined to Colombia’s central Andes, also reaching the eastern Andes in the southern part of the country. Both sexes have a large, white teardrop behind the eye and pale tips to the tail.

name: New Ireland Friarbird
rangeDescription: New ireland (northeastern bismarck archipelago)
description: A large, dark honeyeater with a long, heavy decurved bill. Long bill and tail almost give the impression of a hornbill in flight.

name: Spiny Babbler
rangeDescription: Himalayas of western and central nepal
description: Plain brown babbler with pale eyes and well-streaked underparts. Note the chalky-white face patch in most individuals, though this is more limited or near-absent in a few.

name: Stripe-cheeked Woodpecker
rangeDescription: Humid lowlands and foothills on both slopes of panama
description: This scarce small woodpecker is golden-olive above and barred below. The male has a red crown, a red mustache stripe, and a yellow stripe below the eye.

name: Andaman Treepie
rangeDescription: Dense forest of andaman islands
description: A slender, medium-sized dark bird with a long tail. The face, wings, and tail are black, while the underparts and back are reddish-brown.

name: Blue-winged Pitta
rangeDescription: Southeastern asia to borneo; winters to greater sundas; vagrant to northwestern australia
description: A beautiful, rainbow-colored inhabitant of tropical forests; often bolder than other pittas and occasionally seen in city parks, especially while on migration. Stunning, with green back, blue wings, orange belly, and black mask.

name: Black-rumped Buttonquail
rangeDescription: Ghana to kenya, uganda, and southeastern cape province
description: Small, brownish quail-like bird. Generally rare and elusive species that is unlikely to be seen by those not expressly looking for it.

name: Tanimbar Cuckoo-Dove
rangeDescription: Tanimbar islands (yamdena, larat, and selaru)
description: A large, long-tailed dove. Male is boldly patterned, with dark upperparts and pale underside, each extensively covered in dark barring.

name: Greater Adjutant
rangeDescription: Formerly from northern india to vietnam, dispersing west to pakistan; currently breeds northeastern india (assam) and cambodia, with dispersal west to nepal
description: Immense and imposing undertaker of a stork with a bare head and neck, pale eyes, and dark gray wings. Overlaps in some areas with similar but smaller Lesser Adjutant; note pale wing panel, paler heavier bill, prominent white neck ruff, and when in flight, grayer and less contrasting underwing.

name: Camiguin Bulbul
rangeDescription: Camiguin sur (southern philippines)
description: A fairly large bulbul of forest and forest edge on Camiguin, where it is unmistakable. Dark olive-brown with a pale bill.

name: Japanese Leaf Warbler
rangeDescription: Incompletely known; breeds japan (honshu, shikoku, and kyushu); winter range uncertain
description: Small songbird, a member of the Arctic Warbler complex, this species looks essentially identical to Arctic Warbler and Kamchatka Leaf Warbler but is more evenly yellowish. Normally only distinguished in the field by breeding range and song: breeds in forests on all of the main Japanese islands except Hokkaido, where it is replaced in summer by Kamchatka Leaf Warbler.

name: Yellow-shouldered Amazon
rangeDescription: Coastal northern venezuela including islas margarita and la blanquilla; bonaire
description: Large green parrot of desert Caribbean areas, including mainland. All green with yellow face, yellow shoulder patch, and orange wing patch.

name: Adelaide's Warbler
rangeDescription: Puerto rico including isla de vieques (just east of puerto rico)
description: A small, brightly colored inhabitant of thickets in woodlands and scrub. Feeds actively, snatching insects from leaves and twigs.

name: Southern Scrub-Robin
rangeDescription: Southern australia (shark bay, western australia to western and central new south wales)
description: Long-legged songbird found in semi-arid parts of southern Australia. Grayish above, paler gray below, with faint wingbars and long tail, often flicked upward.
imageCreditName: Laurie Ross | Tracks Birding & Photography Tours

name: White-bibbed Antbird
rangeDescription: Eastern brazil (bahia, minas gerais, espírito santo, and rio de janeiro)
description: Medium sized, long-tailed antbird, which forages on the ground in humid forests. Strikingly patterned, but can be difficult to see.

name: Palau Scops-Owl
rangeDescription: Lowlands of palau (western caroline islands)
description: A reddish-brown owl with a large rounded head, pale whitish eyebrows, and no ear tufts. Upperparts spotted with black-tipped white spots.

name: Blue-tailed Trogon
rangeDescription: Humid forest of western colombia and northwestern ecuador
description: Colorful trogon of lowland and foothill rainforest in western Ecuador and western Colombia. Both sexes have conspicuous white eyes, unmarked black tail, red belly, and mostly yellow bill.

name: Petit's Cuckooshrike
rangeDescription: Southeastern nigeria and cameroon to northeastern democratic republic of the congo, western uganda, and western kenya
description: A forest-dwelling cuckooshrike in which males and females are strikingly different. Males are entirely black with a greenish gloss.
